labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Behaviour is intended: Rich strips control codes when output is not a terminal; reporter confirmed the cause was piping through tee.

body:
This is the expected behaviour. Rich checks whether it is writing to a terminal. When it is not (here, because stdout was piped through `tee`), it strips the control codes that let a progress bar update in place. Running the script directly in a terminal shows the live bar, as you found.

If you need the control codes in a file or pipe, create the `Console` with `force_terminal=True`. The Console docs are at https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst

For general questions about using Rich, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions). Related: #2326.
